name: write-like-me
description: Write, rewrite, or reply in the user's evidence-backed voice while preserving meaning, authorial decisions, and language variety.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the meaning. Learn your evidence-backed voice.
interface.longDescription: Write Like Me by HopLittleBunny drafts or rewrites personal prose, preserves meaning and language variety, removes generic AI texture, and can run a bounded authorial-structure pass without inventing judgement or gaming AI detectors. It builds a portable English writing pattern, verifies rewrite integrity, and learns only corrections the user confirms.
defaultPrompt: Write this email in my voice and keep it paste-ready.
Clean the AI texture, or rethink the structure without inventing my views.
Learn my writing pattern from a few answers.
